verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no test mode, staging workspace, or sandbox environment that lets an agent run against non-production data. The Code Sandbox [gumloop-docs-6] isolates Python and shell execution in the cloud, but it is not shown to separate tests from the real connected data (Gmail, Salesforce, etc.). Human-in-the-loop approvals [gumloop-docs-5] and the 'decision only' model-routing call [gumloop-gh-2] are approval and dry-run controls, not sandbox isolation, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
